What's the real verdict?

SniffTest v1.4 · MIT app · models: nimble (Apache-2.0) + lfm3 (LFM Open License v1.0) ·

🐽 One-time local setup (~2 min)

SniffTest runs on your Ollama — that's why it's private and free. Needs Ollama 0.35+ (decision-model endpoint). If your browser blocks localhost from this page, use Chrome/Edge/Firefox or open the downloaded index.html directly.

“*” lets any website reach your local Ollama. Tighter option: set OLLAMA_ORIGINS to this site's origin instead.

⚙ Settings

Recruitment, phishing, financial and social-engineering packs are selected locally and only add weight when corroborated. The selected category is a routing hint, not proof of fraud.
